top: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters...
bottom: ...come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

top: Arise, shine; for thy light is come,
bottom: and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

top: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory
bottom: in the hand of the LORD...

top: ...ask for the old paths, where is the good way,
bottom: and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls.

top: ...let him that glorieth glory in this,
bottom: that he understandeth and knoweth me...

top: Obey my voice, and I will be your God,
bottom: and ye shall be my people...
